description: Observe-it metrics field normalization and scalar value unification pipeline

script.description: Promote service, version, and env, copy value@int/value@double into unified value, and remove attributes.data_stream
script.source: if (ctx.resource != null) { if (ctx.resource['service.name'] != null) { ctx.service = ctx.resource['service.name']; } if (ctx.resource['service.version'] != null) { ctx.version = ctx.resource['service.version']; } if (ctx.resource['deployment.environment.name'] != null) { ctx.env = ctx.resource['deployment.environment.name']; } } if (ctx.service == null && ctx.serviceName != null) { ctx.service = ctx.serviceName; } if (ctx['value@double'] != null) { ctx.value = ((Number) ctx['value@double']).doubleValue(); } else if (ctx['value@int'] != null) { ctx.value = ((Number) ctx['value@int']).doubleValue(); } if (ctx.attributes != null) { ctx.attributes.remove('data_stream'); }
